name: Bleus Burger
description: Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated. We use 100% FRESH CAB chuck, sourced from Alabama-based, family owned Evans Meats. All burger sauces are made in house daily. Our burgers are 100% fresh, NEVER frozen, premium CAB beef, hand-smashed to order.
